channel.title: The Local France - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Local France (thelocal.fr)

item.title: 8 articles to read before applying for a French 'visitor' visa
item.description: If you're a non-EU citizen moving to France, one of your first tasks is figuring out your visa. You may have heard that France's 'visitor' visa is among the easiest to get, but there are some important things to know before applying.

item.title: Analysis: Is it still worth applying for French citizenship?
item.description: French citizenship brings with it many benefits, but tough new rules mean an increasing number of candidates are being rejected - so is it still worth spending the time and money to apply? And how likely is your application to succeed?

item.title: Hackers steal medical details of 15 million in France
item.description: France's health ministry said Friday that administrative details and medical notes on more than 15 million people had been hacked.

item.title: French word of the day: Fric
item.description: Sometimes in French, all you need is a little fric.

item.title: French hard-left firebrand sparks row with 'antisemitic' Epstein jibe
item.description: France's hard-left firebrand Jean-Luc Melenchon has sparked new accusations of antisemitism after mocking the pronunciation of the name "Epstein" during a rally as calls grew on left-wing politicians Friday to break with the LFI leader.

item.title: Inside France: Diplomatic fisticuffs, Louvre stunts and an unhappy lamb
item.description: From the transatlantic war of diplomatic manners to a literal 'hang it in the Louvre' moment, via a roundup of the best photos of French politicians cuddling animals (or looking scared of a rabbit), Inside France is our weekly look at the latest news and talking points in France.

item.title: Air France adds Dubai, Riyadh to Saturday flight suspensions
item.description: Air France announced Saturday it is suspending flights to Dubai and Riyadh, expanding regional service halts that already included Tel Aviv and Beirut, in the wake of US and Israeli strikes on Iran.

item.title: France seeks UN Security Council meeting on Iran-US conflict
item.description: French President Emmanuel Macron on Saturday called for an urgent meeting of the UN Security Council after the US and Israeli strikes on Iran and Tehran's retaliation, saying the escalation "must stop".

item.title: France warns of 'provocation' as Sweden confirms Russian drone buzzed carrier
item.description: The Swedish military confirmed Friday that a drone jammed near a French aircraft carrier this week was Russian as France slammed the spy attempt as a "ridiculous provocation".

item.title: Macron urges diplomacy, says France not involved in US strikes on Iran
item.description: French President Emmanuel Macron told an emergency defence council he chaired late on Saturday that diplomacy must prevail to calm the conflict pitting the US and Israel against Iran.
